Bratty Bottoms 2, is a slice-of-life roommate visual novel with flirty banter, light comedy, and branching relationships. After moving to the city, you find yourself sharing an apartment with the bossy Chloe and her best friend Sophia. Daily choices, routines, and conversations will shape how your bond with them grows, whether it’s friendship, rivalry, or something deeper.

Genre: Visual Novel + Slice of Life + Roommate Romance

Setting: Shared city apartment

Main Role: A newcomer starting fresh in the city, looking for connections and new friendships

Core Loop:
[list]
[*] Spend time with Chloe and Sophia across different times of day
[*] Make dialogue choices that affect trust, tension, and affection
[*] Balance routines, house rules, and personal boundaries
[*] Unlock special story events through growing relationships
[/list]

Romance Paths:

[b]Chloe: A bratty, teasing “boss” who hides a softer, protective side [/b]

notes.title: GET READY! Only 5 DAYS LEFT UNTIL DELIVERY DAYS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Delivery Days 
[url=https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/619921b3b2109190b0755e153df1b457fd482050.png][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/df7b9824fda007ed68782063bcd6c7dff08aca8c.png[/img][/url]
Releasing on 22nd Aug,

Sometimes the simplest encounters can change everything.

In [h1][b]Delivery Days,[/b][/h1] a visual novel about chance meetings and unexpected bonds, you play as an overworked man who begins to find warmth and connection through the people who step into his life—one knock at the door at a time.

Order food, request help, or simply open the door—and you might find more than you expected waiting on the other side.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860730/Delivery_Days/

[h1][b]Add to your wishlist![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Meet the Characters[/b][/h1]

[b]Mika – The Food Delivery Girl[/b]
Bright, charming, and full of playful energy, Mika is a delivery worker who hides her softer side behind her cap and uniform. When her routine visits turn into something more personal, the line between casual deliveries and heartfelt moments begins to blur.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/5ec6a265a1ab4e971af466947398042f4f45adbc.png[/img]

[b]Rika Akiyama – The Nurse[/b]
Elegant, gentle, and carrying the grace of maturity, Akiyama arrives when Yuuto falls ill from overwork. What begins as a professional check-up slowly grows into something warmer, though her past and vulnerabilities may complicate the bond you share.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/6fbaf2d47f93935a2fefc4f621756cf6ba329200.png[/img]
[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] A modern-day romance visual novel with multiple branching routes.
[*] Experience different stories depending on who you open your heart to.
[*] Slice-of-life warmth mixed with emotional twists.
[*] Choices that determine your relationships and endings.
[*] Will you keep things casual, or let your heart get carried away with every delivery?
[/list]

notes.title: Pookie has a fantasy 2 is out now! Your dream of living with Pookie is finally begins.
notes.notes:
Pookie has a Fantasy 2 is a slice-of-life visual novel. you and your girlfriend Pookie have finally moved in together after overcoming a rocky past. As she chases her dream of becoming a game developer, it’s up to you to keep the lights on, food on the table, and love in the air. Balance work, affection, and choices that shape your future. Will your support be enough to keep her inspired—and by your side?

🎉 Pookie has a fantasy 2 is 10% OFF during the launch sale!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812030/Pookie_has_a_Fantasy_2

Interacting with Pookie will increase her satisfaction level. Keep her mood high to unlock exclusive romantic content.

Dates:
There are multiple dating mini games.

Once you complete a H-scene you can replay that anytime you want.

notes.title: My upcoming game Kindvixens steam page is out now!
notes.notes:
Sit a spell, stranger! Come to the little town of Seabreeze for a visual novel filled with love, community, and just a hint of mystery to pull it all together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837929/b330b294fb140c832efd8c68f612c726aae2dfaa.gif[/img]

Bet you’re just itching to meet everyone. We have a whole host of fun characters, among them are about 11 women, all of differing personalities, all brought to life through hand-drawn, lovingly made, anime-inspired art! Come meet them and the rest of the cast as the story comes together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837929/953cf317aed3c18bee3816cae237f1ffaae88bd2.gif[/img]


How does one find these girls? Don’t think too hard about it. Seabreeze ain’t the kind of town that will breathe down your neck to make you find everything. The story you get here is straightforward and simple. If you wanna find the girls, you’ll find them easily enough if you put your ear to the ground. Beyond them, there are quite a fair bit of locations for you to explore. Just keep your nose to the ground though, you never know who or what you might find in a little town like this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837929/e2490614bbc71f7ea5f9457de7f4a1fb6e0e7ec9.gif[/img]

Ah, you’re wondering more about the ladies here eh? Well, they’re a kindly sort. Most love to meet new people, and each one comes with an interesting host of quirks and needs. Some might help you get jobs, others will need things from you, but all of them are looking for something in life…and who knows, that something might just be you. Careful though…who knows what secrets these girls might be keeping about themselves…or the town itself.

So come along, meet them…and who knows, someone might get a little lucky, eh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837929/46eed1662a7218a9473c09b52078da90c2bd6cff.gif[/img]


Featuring:

11 unique, charming and kinky ladies
Very Lite Survival Mechanics!
Minigames!
Make decisions about the relationships you make
Become part of the local community and help the townsfolk!
Solve the mystery plaguing the town!
